## Documented role

None recorded from a contemporaneous 1980s source inspected in this archive. Later journalism and an SCI BC feature identify him as a Creekview resident and independent-living advocate.

## Attributed recollection

[Fayerman, *Vancouver Sun*, 20 September 2018](../sources/2018-vancouversun-walt-lawrence.qmd) reports Lawrence describing a 1985 move into “the Creekview Co-operative Apartment near Granville Island,” after a Canadian Paraplegic Association cost analysis, and crediting MLA Doug Mowat. [SCI BC, “Walt’s Time,” 2019](../sources/2019-sci-bc-walts-time.qmd) retells related material and uses the spelling “Creekside.” Those are later accounts. They do not, by themselves, define a role in CSIL (as opposed to earlier independent living / Creekview).
